solution_title: On-Demand Delivery Checkout, Zone Validation & Live Tracker
summary: Shared Phase 2 architecture for an end-to-end Chicago restaurant and grocery delivery checkout and live order-tracking web app across all 8 stacks. Anchored at a Fulton Market kitchen hub (41.8868, -87.6486) and seeded with a live Chicago customer address (401 N Michigan Ave, Chicago, IL 60611), the app combines Places API (New) PlaceAutocompleteElement (gmp-select + event.placePrediction.toPlace().fetchFields) with Address Validation API deliverability/granularity checks (weekly-safe verdict fields: validationGranularity, geocodeGranularity, addressComplete, hasUnconfirmedComponents, hasInferredComponents, hasReplacedComponents, metadata, and USPS data). It verifies eligibility against both a Chicago delivery zone Polygon (google.maps.geometry.poly.containsLocation) and an 8 km road-distance cap computed via Routes API (Route.computeRoutes on pure-client stacks; /api/routes/compute BFF on Next.js, FastAPI, and Node.js Express), calculates tiered delivery fees ($2.99 <= 3 km, $4.99 <= 5.5 km, $6.99 <= 8 km) and traffic-aware ETA, renders custom AdvancedMarkerElement pins (Kitchen, Customer, and smoothly animated Courier interpolated along the decoded route polyline via requestAnimationFrame), and generates an Order Receipt Card embedding a live Maps Static API route summary image. Zero legacy/deprecated APIs are used, mapId="DEMO_MAP_ID" and internalUsageAttributionIds=["gmp_git_agentsamples_v1.0.0"] are enforced everywhere, and all servers bind strictly to 127.0.0.1 with security headers.
ui_layout_summary: Responsive split-screen layout with a 64px top bar (brand title, Fulton Market Kitchen Hub badge, and live zone/tracking status pill), a 440px scrollable left sidebar containing three stacked cards (1. Checkout Address Autocomplete & Address Validation Verdict + Polygon/8km Eligibility; 2. Tiered Delivery Fee, Traffic-Aware ETA & Live Courier Dispatch Controls; 3. Itemized Order Receipt Card with Maps Static API route preview image), and a full-height right interactive map panel (min-height: 560px / calc(100vh - 64px)) showing the Chicago delivery zone Polygon, Routes API Polyline, custom Kitchen/Customer/Courier AdvancedMarkerElement pins, and a floating map legend + live ETA badge.

backend_proxy_endpoints.purpose: Server-side BFF proxy for Address Validation API (v1:validateAddress) returning validationGranularity, geocodeGranularity, addressComplete, standardized address lines, coordinates, Place ID, property metadata, and USPS CASS/DPV deliverability signals with X-Goog-Api-Key kept on the server.

Server-side BFF proxy for Routes API v2 (computeRoutes) calculating traffic-aware driving distanceMeters, duration, encodedPolyline, and turn-by-turn steps between the Chicago kitchen hub and validated drop-off location.

backend_proxy_endpoints.field_mask: N/A (Maps Static API uses URL query parameters: size, scale, maptype, markers, path, key)
backend_proxy_endpoints.purpose: Server-side BFF proxy for Maps Static API returning PNG route summary map bytes for the order receipt card (kitchen marker, drop-off marker, and encoded route polyline) without exposing the server API key in client HTML image URLs.
